entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: This psalm contains an enumeration of God's wonderful dealings in behalf of his people, from Abraham till their settlement in the land of Canaan.
, occurs in the psalm sung on the removal of the ark to mount Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: The Lord is the source of all excellence and bliss, and those who seek him as their chief good have cause for perpetual gladness and joy.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: His covenant; in which he promised to give to the seed of Abraham the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: Jehovah is unchangeable, and when the word hath gone out of his mouth it standeth for ever.  Heaven and earth may pass away, but his word will never pass away.

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: Reproved kings;

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments:
Mine anointed; set apart, endowed with special gifts to qualify them for their office. 
 
  Prophets;

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: Brake the whole staff; cut off the means of support.  The reference is to the famine which occasioned the descent of Jacob and his family into Egypt.
, etc.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: God raises up deliverers for his people, such as from time to time they need, and sends them to fulfil his promises and accomplish his purposes of love and mercy to his chosen.

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: His word; that is, according to some, the effect of Joseph's word in interpreting the dreams of Pharoah's butler and baker.

But others understand by "his word," God's word of promise to Joseph in his early dreams. 
 
  The word of the Lord tried him; God's promise to Joseph tried him by its long delay.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: The land of Ham; Egypt, which was peopled with the descendants of Ham, one of the sons of Noah.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: The condition of nations, as well as of individuals, is ordered by the Lord; he sends prosperity or adversity according to his infinitely wise and good pleasure, and as will promote his own glory and the good of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: They rebelled not; according to some, Moses and Aaron rebelled not, but executed God's commands punctually.  But it is better to understand these words of the Egyptians, who when the plague came relented, as usual, and promised obedience.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: When God would fulfil his purposes of love and mercy, it is vain for men to oppose him.  They may destroy themselves, but they cannot withstand the power of God.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments:
The fear of them; the Israelites. 
 
  Fell upon them; the Egyptians.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: The bread of heaven; given miraculously from above.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: His holy promise; to give their descendants the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: The labor of the people; the riches accumulated by their labor.

The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof, and when he takes any part of it away from one people on account of their sins, and gives ti to another, he wrongs no one, but does what he will with his own.
